Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from a cracker of a game! Bangladesh go into the next game with a lead in the series and will be hoping to pull off consecutive home series wins against India. The visitors have a massive task to try and salvage the series but they will definitely come back stronger. The second ODI will be played on Wednesday 7th December and the game starts at 11.30 am IST (6 am GMT). Do join us for the build-up which begins well in advance. Cheers!

Litton Das the skipper of Bangladesh says that sitting in the dressing room they were nervous but Mustafizur Rahman and Mehidy Hasan did really well. Mentions that India bowled well in the middle overs and that helped shift their momentum on their side. Claims that when he and Shakib Al Hasan were batting he felt that they could get the target easily but it was all about Mehidy Hasan who batted really well.

Mehidy Hasan in the Player of the Match for his match-winning knock of 38. He says that it is a good opportunity for him and he is really excited. Explains that he told Mustafizur to stay calm and that he needs to believe and he knew he could do it. Claims that he wanted to bowl stump to stump and keep it tight. Says he is very, very happy with his performance.

Rohit Sharma the captain of India says that the game was really close. Adds that they did well to come back in the game and get to a good position. Mentions that they did not bat well but the bowlers did a good job. Goes on to say that the Bangladesh batters held their nerves and got there in the end. Claims that in the last few overs they would have liked to take a wicket. Credits the bowlers for bowling well for the first 40 overs as they did a good job and the bowlers kept taking wickets. Feels that another 30 to 40 runs would have helped them a lot. Says that with KL Rahul and Washington Sundar batting they were hoping to get to 250. Explains that they lost wickets in the start and through the middle as well. Adds that with the pitch being challenging, they need to understand how to play on these kinds of surfaces. Reckons that playing on the wicket should not be a problem as most of the players grew up playing like this. Ends by saying that they know what we need to do and they hope to turn things around in the next game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, India struggled to start well with the bat losing the top three batters cheaply. Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul steadied the ship to help India recover from that precarious start. Once the former was dismissed, the onus was on KL Rahul to bat through and allow India to post a respectable total. He kept the runs flowing for India while losing partners at the other end. His dismissal meant India were unable to cross the 200-run mark and were bundled out without playing the full quota of 50 overs.

Bangladesh were off to a cautious start while chasing a low total losing Najmul Hossain Shanto early. Litton Das and Anamul Haque rode on luck and did well to not lose any more wickets against the moving new ball. Then, Litton Das and Shakib Al Hasan joined hands to take the game deep. Once these two were dismissed, it was the experienced pair of Mahmudullah and Mushfiqur Rahim who took the chase forward. But, both set batters were dismissed on consecutive deliveries to put Bangladesh in a spot of bother. Thereon, Bangladesh lost their way in the chase and were quickly nine down and staring at defeat. That's when Mehidy Hasan took matters into his own hands along with Mustafizur Rahman for support and guided Bangladesh home from a losing position.

What an outstanding knock from Mehidy Hasan! He has been the hero for Bangladesh and the crowd is going berserk! An emphatic win for Bangladesh and they snatched victory from the jaws of defeat. At 136-9, they were down and out but, Mehidy Hasan brings it home from them out of nowhere. India will be rueing the opportunity they had to seal they game but KL Rahul dropped an easy catch with the gloves on. Bangladesh have taken a 1-0 lead in the series and beat India for the sixth time in ODIs.

What a win for Bangladesh as they seal a 1-wicket win! Deepak Chahar bowls this on a good length, outside the off pole. Mehidy Hasan cuts this over the infield on the off side and gets his to team across the finish line with a single!

THE SCORES ARE LEVEL! The crowd erupts! Deepak Chahar bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mustafizur Rahman clips this towards square leg and takes a quick single. There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end but replays show that Mustafizur Rahman has made it into the crease. It also brings up the 50-run partnership for the 10th wicket!
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Mustafizur Rahman swings at the ball but does not connect. This will be a dot ball.

NO BALL! This is short and outside off, Mehidy Hasan pulls this towards deep backward square leg. They took a run expecting to take two but good fielding in the deep gets Mustafizur Rahman on strike. Wait a moment! What has Deepak Chahar done? He oversteps and Bangladesh gets a Free Hit with 2 runs left to win.
This is short and well outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan flays his blade at the ball but does not connect.
Bowls this short as well but closer to the off pole, Mehidy Hasan looks to pull initially but backs out at the last moment.
FOUR! Bangladesh are one hit away from a massive win! This is bowled short and outside off, Mehidy Hasan cuts this towards deep backward square leg for four runs! Four runs to win for Bangladesh!
Bowls this on a good length as well and outside off, Mehidy Hasan walks across to the off side and pulls this towards deep square leg to take a run and keep strike.
This is on a good length and outside off, Mehidy Hasan looks to pull this but the ball is not short enough and it goes under the bat towards the keeper.
On a good length and outside the off pole, Mustafizur Rahman guides this towards third man for a single. Bangladesh are sensing something here and the crowd is pumped. 9 more needed.

FOUR! Bangladesh are getting closer now and Mustafizur Rahman contributes with a boundary! This is angled down leg side on a fuller length, he clips the ball towards fine leg for four runs. Just 10 runs needed now!
Bowls this outside the off stump. Mustafizur Rahman taps this towards cover.
This is on a good length from 'round the wicket and angled into the stumps, Mustafizur Rahman blocks this back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Mehidy Hasan puts this away for four runs and now Mustafizur Rahman will be on strike in the next over! Deepak Chahar bowls this back of a length and in line with the stumps, Mehidy Hasan pulls this towards deep square leg and a misfield from Washington Sundar allows a boundary to sneak through. 14 runs are needed in 36 balls!

Goes slightly fuller, outside off, Mehidy Hasan strokes this towards deep backward point and they look for two. The fielder does well and they have to settle for one. There is no one backing up the throw at the non-striker's end though and they take the second run.
This is bowled outside off on a good length, Mehidy Hasan gets an under edge as he looks to cut and the ball rolls towards the keeper.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Deepak Chahar goes back of a length once again and outside off, Mehidy Hasan slices this towards deep backward point for yet another boundary. 20 runs are needed now in 39 balls.

FOUR! Mehidy Hasan is getting the better of Deepak Chahar here! Mehidy Hasan moves around in the wicket and gets into position for a paddle shot. Deepak Chahar bowls a low full toss outside off, Mehidy Hasan connects and gets this to fine leg for four runs.
Bowls this short and outside off, Mehidy Hasan hits this into the air towards deep cover and Shikhar Dhawan takes a catch running back. They do not take a single and it will be a dot ball.
NO BALL! Slower bowler has gone wrong! Bowls a very high full toss outside off, Mehidy Hasan slashes at this but can not get it beyond cover. It will be a Free Hit for Bangladesh!
On a good length and angled into the pads, Mehidy Hasan looks to clip this leg side but misses. Goes off his pads to fine leg and they get a leg bye to keep which keeps Mehidy Hasan on strike.
This is bowled on a fuller length and wide outside off, Mehidy Hasan charges down the wicket and just about digs it out towards cover.

This is short as well and outside off, Mehidy Hasan backs away and cuts this towards third man. Washington Sundar seems to lose the ball in the lights as he lets it land in front of him. No run taken once again.

What a massive moment in the game! Shardul Thakur bowls this short and in line with the stumps and Mehidy Hasan looks to pull this. The ball takes a top edge and flies high towards the fine leg region. KL Rahul runs towards the ball and settles under it. The ball takes forever to get down and he fumbles it despite having the gloves. What a let-off for Bangladesh. Will this prove to be expensive for India?
Bowls this one back of a length and outside off, Mehidy Hasan cuts this hard towards the wide third man fielder and does not take a single.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Mehidy Hasan makes room and looks to go straight but does not connect. The extra bounce takes the ball over the stumps.
How did that miss the stumps? Mohammed Siraj nails the yorker and it looks to seam in late. Skims the off stump as Mustafizur Rahman is unable to get his bat down in time. That was really close.
This is bowled back of a length and in line with the stumps. The ball stays slightly low but Mehidy Hasan manages to pull this towards deep square leg for a single.
Bowls this on a yorker length and outside the off stump. Mehidy Hasan digs this out towards point. Four dot balls in this over so far and Mehidy Hasan will need to look for a single as well.
Goes full this time and just outside off, Mehidy Hasan heaves but mistimes his shot towards mid-wicket.
This is on a good length and closer to the stumps, Mehidy Hasan gets behind the line of the ball and defends this back towards the bowler.
Mohammed Siraj bowls this short and wide outside off, Mehidy Hasan charges down the pitch and swings wildly. Gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bangs this in short from 'round the wicket and into the batter. Mustafizur Rahman ducks under this one and lets it go through to the keeper.
Goes full and into the pads, Mehidy Hasan clips this towards deep square leg and they take a single this time.

SIX! This is exactly why he wants to keep the strike! Kuldeep Sen has been way too short in this over and offers width outside off once again. Mehidy Hasan connects and the ball flies over deep backward point for six more runs! 34 runs are needed now in 56 balls!
This is outside the off stump on a shorter length, Mehidy Hasan guides this to third man but will continue to refuse the run.
This is bowled back of a length and into the batter, Mehidy Hasan is hurried into his pull shot as he gets the ball away to deep square leg. They do not take a single though.

SIX! Bangladesh have decided to throw the kitchen sink at it! Kuldeep Sen bangs this in short as well and wide outside off, Mehidy Hasan slashes hard and connects this time. The ball flies over the deep backward point boundary for a biggie!
WIDE! Bowls this short and way outside the off pole, Mehidy Hasan swings but the ball is way too far away. The umpire calls this wide.
Bowls this on a good length and angled into the stumps, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to block and gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! That has been stroked away beautifully! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good length and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim finds the gap on the off side and the ball races away to the deep cover-point boundary to bring some cheer to the crowd.
Mohammed Siraj goes 'round the wicket and bowls this full, into the stumps. Mustafizur Rahman gets his bat down in time and keeps the ball out.
Mustafizur Rahman walks in at number 11 for Bangladesh.

OUT! PLUMB! Bangladesh are crumbling here and there are one wicket away from losing this game! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good length and just outside off, The ball nips back in towards the stumps and Hasan Mahmud is unable to block this out. The ball hits him on his pads and the Mohammed Siraj is convinced that is out. The umpire agrees and raises his finger but Hasan Mahmud goes for the review. There is no movement on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking shows three reds. India should be confident of sealing the win now.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Mehidy Hasan guides this to deep backward point and takes a single.
WIDE! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good length but angles this down leg side. Mehidy Hasan misses his flick and KL Rahul dives to his left to collect the ball. The umpire calls this one wide.
This is bowled slightly full and just outside off, Hasan Mahmud blocks this solidly towards cover.

OUT! HIT WICKET! Kuldeep Sen has the second wicket in the over and Ebadot Hossain has brought about his own downfall! Kuldeep Sen bowls this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Ebadot Hossain is really deep in the crease as he is worried about the bowler's speed. He manages to clip the ball towards fine leg but in the process steps on the stump. Virat Kohli at short leg is the first to see it and runs off celebrating. Bangladesh have lost their eight wicket now and are staring down a barrel of defeat.
Who walks in now?
WIDE! Kuldeep Sen bowls this full and angling down leg, Ebadot Hossain fails to connect his flick. The umpire calls this wide.
Bangs this in short but really wide outside off. Ebadot Hossain slashes at the ball but is late into his shot.
Really close! Bowls this on a fuller length and just outside off, Ebadot Hossain is stuck deep in the crease and hangs his bat out. The ball beats his bat and the off pole by a fraction.
Ebadot Hossain is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A first international wicket for Kuldeep Sen! What a moment for this player and he has taken India one step closer to sealing an unlikely win! He bangs this in short and outside off, Afif Hossain looks to cut this square on the offside but does not connect cleanly. The ball floats towards deep backward point where Mohammed Siraj takes a juggling catch to get India their seventh wicket. The Indian players look ecstatic on the field and they sense victory here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammed Siraj b Kuldeep Sen

Commentary.Commentary: Kuldeep Sen starts off with a full delivery outside off, Afif Hossain miscues his shot towards mid on.
Full and angling in on off, Mehidy Hasan gets forward and drives it towards the bowler for a dot.
Fuller on off, Mehidy Hasan pushes it to mid on and sets off for a quick single. Gets sent back by Afif Hossain.
Short on off, Afif Hossain taps it gently to the left of Shreyas Iyer at backward point and takes a quick single.
Back of a length on off, Afif Hossain pushes it off the back foot towards point for a dot.
Short of a length on off, Afif Hossain pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short and outside off, Afif Hossain opens the bat face and slashes hard at the away going delivery. Hits it wide of third man and collects a brace.
Slower and short at the pads, Afif Hossain works it off the back foot towards fine leg for a single.
Banged in short and at the batter by Shardul Thakur, Afif Hossain ducks under it and lets it go.
Fuller on off, straightens after pitching to beat the outside edge of Afif Hossain as he tried to defend.
Good-length delivery outside off from round the wicket, keeps a bit low as it goes the past the outside edge.
Back of a length on middle, Afif Hossain pushes this one towards mid-wicket for a dot.
Full and outside off, Afif Hossain gets forward and lofts this one over mid on with a straight bat. Gets off the mark with a brace.

Good-length delivery outside off, Mehidy Hasan frees his arms and goes for the drive without much feet movement. The ball flies past the outside edge through to the keeper. A wicket maiden by Mohammed Siraj.
Short and shaping into the batter, Mehidy Hasan looks to defend this one but gets rapped high on the pads as he gets beaten by the sharp bounce.
Short on off, Mehidy Hasan makes room and punches it off the back foot straight to backward point.
Short of a length on off, Mehidy Hasan stays in the crease to defend and gets an inside edge back onto his foot.
Fuller and sliding onto the pads, Mehidy Hasan looks to flick this one and gets hit on the pads.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! CHOPPED IT ON! Two wickets in two deliveries for India and this time it is Mohammed Siraj who dismisses Mushfiqur Rahim! This is bowled back of a length, on off and nips back in. Mushfiqur Rahim gets cramped for room as he tried to work this one fine on the off side. Ends by dragging it back onto his stumps off his gloves. Both set batters back in the hut for Bangladesh. India are right back into the game as Bangladesh are now six wickets down.
Who walks in to bat now?

OUT! LBW! Shardul Thakur has been rewarded for some outstanding bowling! He has the big wicket of Mahmudullah and there could be some jitters in the Bangladesh camp now! Shardul Thakur goes really full and gets the ball to pitch on the off stump, the ball nips back in sharply. Mahmudullah falls over the line off the ball and gets hit flush on the pads. Massive appeal from the Indian players around the bat and the umpire raises his finger. Mahmudullah has opted for the review and UltraEdge confirms that the bat is far from the ball. Ball Tracking has umpires call on wickets hitting and the onfield decision remains. Bangladesh have lost half their side now and India may sense a way through here.
This is short and wide outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim hits this well but finds the deep point fielder and it will be a single.
Good-length delivery bowled outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim slashes at the ball but gets an inside edge into the pitch.
Goes full and fires this down leg side. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to clip this fine but misses. The ball clips the pads and there is a stifled appeal once again.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this towards point and Shreyas Iyer puts in a lovely dive to stop the ball.

Shardul Thakur begins with a good-length delivery nipping back in sharply. Mushfiqur Rahim plays all over this one and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal from Shardul Thakur but the umpire says not out. They do not review this and it is a good decision as the ball is going over the stumps.
Bowls this full and angling down leg, Mahmudullah looks to work this leg side but misses. An appeal from the players but the umpire remains unmoved.
FOUR BYES! Mohammed Siraj bangs this in short and going down leg. Mahmudullah ducks under this one and KL Rahul does not get hold of the ball. He parries it towards fine leg for four extra runs.
On a good length and on an outside off stump line, Mahmudullah gets squared up but manages to block the ball to the off side.
WIDE! Bangs this in short and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to duck but realizes that the ball is way too high. The leg umpire indicates that this is wide.
Angling down leg on a fuller length, Mahmudullah looks to clip this fine but misses and the ball flicks against the pads. KL Rahul does well to stop the ball by diving to his left.
On a good length and just outside off stump, Mahmudullah lets the ball hit his bat and it rolls back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Mohammed Siraj starts off with a full delivery angled into the stumps, Mahmudullah gets his bat down in time and taps the ball towards square leg.
Goes full and outside off, Mahmudullah taps this to the off side and just manages to beat the Virat Kohli at cover. They take a single and Mahmudullah will be on strike in the next over.
Continue bowling on a good length and gets this closer to the off stump. Mahmudullah gets himself behind the line of the ball and defends it towards point.
On a good length once again and outside the off stump, Mahmudullah dabs the ball towards point.
This is on a good length and just outside the off pole. The ball stays really low and goes under the toes of the bat through to the keeper. Misses the stumps by a fraction.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim rides the bounce and guides the ball to wide third man for a single.
Shardul Thakur starts the over with a full delivery outside off, Mahmudullah knocks this firmly to deep cover and takes a single.
Flighted full and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim knocks this towards cover where Virat Kohli pounces on the ball in a jiffy.
Bowls this quicker in the air and in line with the stumps on a fuller length. Mahmudullah pushes at this and gets and inside edge towards deep backward square leg for one.
Bowls this short and outside off. The turn takes the ball away and Mahmudullah leaves this one alone.
Fires this in full and into the stumps, Mahmudullah manages to dig this one out to the off side.
Floats this one full as well outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to paddle this fine but does not connect well and the ball goes to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this full and just outside the off stump, Mushfiqur Rahim blocks this back towards the bowler.

Goes back to bowling on a good length and just outside the off pole, Mahmudullah looks to heave this to the leg side but the ball is not short enough. Gets hit high on the pads and there is an uppeal from the bowler and Virat Kohli. KL Rahul behind the wicket is not interested though and the umpire remains unmoved.
Delivers this slightly full and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim strokes this towards deep cover for a single.
Bowls on a good length once again and outside the off pole, Mushfiqur Rahim defends this solidly towards point.
Goes full this time and angles the ball into the stumps from outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim just about manages to flick this towards mid-wicket.
On a good length this time and outside the off stump, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to guide this past point but Shreyas Iyer does well diving to his left.
Shardul Thakur starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim cuts this straight to point.
Tossed up on off, Mahmudullah gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to extra cover for a dot.
Shorter on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim makes room and punches this one towards deep cover for a single.
Low full-toss at the pads, Mushfiqur Rahim uses his feet and works this one wide of deep mid-wicket to collect a brace.
Short on off, Mahmudullah guides it off the back foot past backward point for a single.
Flighted outside off, Mahmudullah gets forward and leaves it alone.
Short outside off and turning away, keeps a bit low but Mahmudullah does well and cuts it wide of deep cover. Collects a couple of runs.

DRINKS! The players will take some refreshments and will have an opportunity to analyze their plans going forward. Bangladesh are in a good position so far and they bat pretty deep so this should be a routine run chase. India will be eager to take some quick wickets and put the hosts under pressure. Will they be able to do so? We will find out shortly.
Full outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim knocks this one to extra cover for a dot.
Fuller outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it to Virat Kohli at extra cover. Virat Kohli has a few words to say to the batter.
Short of a length on off, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it off the back foot to cover for a dot.
Short and outside off, bounces sharply past the batter. Mushfiqur Rahim pokes at it and is lucky to not get a edge there. Shardul Thakur goes up in appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Fuller and outside off, Mahmudullah drives it nicely towards deep cover and takes a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mahmudullah shoulders arms and lets it go through to the keeper.
Touch shorter and turning away, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it from the crease to backward point for a dot.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Good-length delivery on off, Mahmudullah defends this one off the front foot.
Flighted on middle, Mahmudullah gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah goes for the cut but gets an under edge that goes past Rohit Sharma at first slip on the bounce. The batters run two in the process.
Short on off and turning away, Mahmudullah punches it off the back foot to extra cover for a dot.
Full and drifting onto the pads, Mahmudullah clips it nicely towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, nips away from pitching, Mahmudullah goes for a waft outside off and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length and angling in, Mahmudullah looks to tuck this one of the leg side and gets hit high on the pads.
Touch fuller on off, Mushfiqur Rahim uses his feet and drives it to mid off and takes a quick single.
WIDE! Full and wide down the leg side, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to clip this one away but misses.
Shorter on leg, Mahmudullah tucks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot to cover for a dot.
Short outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim opens the bat face and guides it past short third man. Collects a couple of runs.

Appeal for run-out! Flighted on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim gets across and paddles this behind square on the leg side. The fielder fires in a throw to the keeper who takes the bails off and the umpire sends it upstairs. The replays show that Mushfiqur Rahim is well in.
Tossed up on off, Mushfiqur Rahim gets forward and drives it to mid-wicket.
Quicker on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim pushes this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Flatter on off, Mushfiqur Rahim works it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Shorter on off, Mahmudullah tries to defend this one but gets an inside that rolls towards square leg for a single.
Maiden to start off for Shardul Thakur!
Make that five! Bowled on a good length once again and outside the off stump, Mushfiqur Rahim punches this towards the point fielder.
BEATEN! Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim hangs his bat out to dry and is beaten all ends up. Four dot balls now.
Continue bowling on a good length and attacking the oof pole. Gets an extra bit of bounce this time as the batter fends the ball back into the pitch.
On a good length and on an off stump line. Mushfiqur Rahim defends this back towards the bowler.
Shardul Thakur starts off with a good-length delivery outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim blocks this to the off side.
Shardul Thakur is introduced into the attack.
Full and into the pads, Mahmudullah clips this towards square leg and they decide against taking a run.
This is short as well and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim is surprised by the extra bounce as he punches this past point for a single.
This is short and outside off, Mahmudullah eases this to deep point and takes a single to get off the mark.
Mahmudullah walks in at number 6 for Bangladesh.

OUT! CAUGHT! This has been a day of stunning catches! Virat Kohli pulls off a massive one-handed catch to dismiss the dangerous Shakib Al Hasan. Washington Sundar floats this one full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to thump this through the off side but plays it in the air. Virat Kohli dives to his right and takes the catch in mid-air just the way Litton Das did in the first inning. A massive smile on the face of Virat Kohli and India have an opening here. Bangladesh have lost their fourth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: This is slightly short and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan cuts this one straight to the point fielder.
Looped up and bowled full outside off, Shakib Al Hasan is down the wicket once again but taps it towards point.
Another flighted delivery full and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim defends this to the cover fielder.
Full once again and into the pads, Shakib Al Hasan shimmies down the wicket and eases the ball to long on for one.

FOUR! Two boundaries in a row! Flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan sweeps this towards deep square leg and collects four more runs. Bangladesh are running away with this one now courtesy of Shakib Al Hasan.
FOUR! This has been crunched through covers! Shahbaz Ahmed floats this one full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan stays deep in the crease and pounds this towards deep cover for four runs.
Floats this one into the pads on the fuller length, Shakib Al Hasan charges down the wicket and clips the ball to mid-wicket.
Shahbaz Ahmed bowls this full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan gets low to cut but finds the backward point fielder.
Fired into the pads on a fuller length, Mushfiqur Rahim clips this towards square leg and looks for a run. Shakib Al Hasan refuses as he probably wants to keep strike.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan mistimes his shot to long off for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim plays this late into the backward point region and takes one.
Bowls this one full and outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim taps this back towards the bowler.
Flights this one full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan shimmies down and lofts it towards deep cover and they take three runs comfortably.
Washington Sundar bowls this short after seeing the batter charge and serves it quicker in the air. Shakib Al Hasan defends this back towards the bowler.
This is aimed for the middle stump on a fuller length, Mushfiqur Rahim gets his front foot forward and smothers the ball into the pitch.
Goes full and angling down leg, Shakib Al Hasan sweeps this towards deep backward square leg and takes one. Bangladesh are rotating the strike nicely.
Angles this into the pads on a fuller length, Mushfiqur Rahim clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes another single.
Bowls this straight and on a fuller length. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks this back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Bowls this in line with the stumps on a fuller length. Shakib Al Hasan clips the ball to the leg side and takes another quick run.
Shahbaz Ahmed floats this one full and just outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim taps the ball towards point and takes a quick single.
Flatter on middle, Shakib Al Hasan pushes it back to the bowler for a dot. An eventful over comes to an end.
Quicker on middle, Mushfiqur Rahim turns it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Fuller on middle, Shakib Al Hasan gets forward and pushes it to long on for a single.

Back of a length on off, Mushfiqur Rahim taps it fine towards short third man. Shakib Al Hasan calls him for a single and there is a mixup between the two. Deepak Chahar underarms it to Washington Sundar at the non-striker's end and Mushfiqur Rahim is safely in. A better throw and Mushfiqur Rahim would have been out.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes out to replace his skipper and Bangladesh will need to consolidate once again.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! India have the breakthrough and this partnership has finally been broken! Shorter on leg and it turns sharply down the leg side, Litton Das gets across to help it on the leg side. There is the slightest of touches on the glove as it goes through to the keeper. KL Rahul moves quickly to his left and takes a good catch. A timely wicket for India as Litton Das was threatening to take the game away from them.
Commentary.Howout: c KL Rahul b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up outside off and turning in, Litton Das works this one to square leg for a dot.
Fuller on middle, Litton Das knocks this one towards point for a single.
Quicker on off, Litton Das plays this one off the back foot towards the bowler.
FOUR! Flighted on off, Litton Das gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one towards the mid-wicket fence. Proactive batting by Litton Das.
Short on off, Litton Das rocks back and punches this one off the back foot towards cover for a dot.
Quicker on middle, Shakib Al Hasan uses his feet to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge that flies towards point for a single.
Short outside off and turning away, Litton Das makes room and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Fuller outside off, Litton Das guides it towards deep point and takes a single.
Flighted at the pads, Shakib Al Hasan clips this one towards square leg for a single.
Full and sliding in, Shakib Al Hasan works this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Flatter on middle, Shakib Al Hasan plays this one off the back foot to cover for a dot.
Fuller on middle, Shakib Al Hasan makes room and defends it back to the bowler.
Starts with a shorter delivery on off and turning away, Shakib Al Hasan pushes it off the back foot to cover for a dot.
We will have spin from both ends as Washington Sundar has been brought into the attack.
Flatter and quicker on off from over the wicket, Shakib Al Hasan guides it from his crease to short third man and rushes for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive this one through the covers but gets an inside edge that rolls towards short third man for a dot.
Quicker on leg, Litton Das makes room and works it towards cover for a single.
Shortens his length and this one spins away, Litton Das gets beaten on the outside edge as he tried to defend.
Tossed up on middle, Shakib Al Hasan uses his feet and drives it along the ground to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Litton Das gets on the front foot and pushes this one to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, Litton Das frees his arms and drives it crisply to deep cover for a run. A good end to the over for Bangladesh.
SIX! Short and punished! Short and at the batter, Litton Das gets into the position early and pulls this one behind square on the leg side. Clears the fence and collects a maximum.
Back of a length at the pads, Shakib Al Hasan works it towards fine leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Litton Das guides this one to the right of backward point, Shreyas Iyer fails to collect it cleanly and concedes a single.
Short of a length on off, not much room for the batter, Litton Das defends this one to cover for a dot.
WIDE! Full and drifting down the leg side, Litton Das goes for the flick but misses.
Back of a length on off, Litton Das defends this one off the back foot to point for a dot.
This is tossed up full and outside off, Litton Das strokes this to the long off fielder and take another single to keep strike.
Bowls this full an outside the off pole, Shakib Al Hasan gives the bowler the charge but mishits the ball to long off for one.
This is full as well and just outside off, Shakib Al Hasan goes deep in the crease and dabs it towards short fine leg.
Fires this in full and in line with stumps, Litton Das looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards the backward square leg region. They take a run.
Keeps this straight as well and on a fuller length. Litton Das happy to defend this to the cover fielder.
Floats this full and into the stumps, Litton Das blocks this towards cover.

Time for drinks! India got off to the perfect start dismissing Najmul Hossain Shanto on the very first delivery. They continued to beat the edge of the Bangladeshi batters but without much success. Mohammed Siraj was finally rewarded for his effort when Anamul Haque chipped it straight to mid-wicket. Since then, Litton Das and Shakib Al Hasan have done well to stitch a partnership and keep the scoreboard ticking. India need to break this partnership soon to have any chance of winning this game.
This is angling down leg on a fuller length, Litton Das flicks this straight to deep square leg for a single. The most expensive over of the inning so far as 8 runs have come off it.
Goes full and outside the off pole, Litton Das strokes this to deep cover and they get a couple of runs.
FOUR! Probably the first loose delivery from India all game! This is short and wide, asking to be hit. Litton Das lifts this towards the vacant deep point region and collects four runs.
Slightly short and outside off, Litton Das looks to pull this but gets an inside edge onto his legs and the ball goes towards point.
Goes full this time and wide outside the off pole, Litton Das goes for the expansive drive but does not connect.

Another half chance for India but there is only one slip in place. Kuldeep Sen bowls this slightly back of a length and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to play this square but gets a thickish edge that flies towards third man for a single.
Flights this one full and outside off, Litton Das gets forward and blocks this towards the cover fielder. Really good over from Shahbaz Ahmed.
This is short and outside off, Litton Das looks to cut but gets beaten by th extra bounce this time.

FOUR BYES! Massive turn for Shahbaz Ahmed! Floats this on full and just outside off. Litton Das looks to force this through the off side but gets beaten by the turn. The ball not only beats the outside edge but also the keeper to reach the boundary for four byes.

That is really close! This is flighted full and outside off, Litton Das pushes at this one and gets a thick outside edge towards slip. Rohit Sharma makes a fine attempt going low to his right and taking the catch. The bowler is already celebrating as the umpires get together to see if the catch is taken properly. They go upstairs and the soft signal is not out. Replays show that the ball has just bounced before entering the skipper's hand and Litton Das survives.
The umpires will go upstairs to check if the catch has been taken cleanly. The soft signal says that the umpires do not think that the catch has been taken and the televsion umpire confirms it.
Goes wide outside off on a fuller length. Shakib Al Hasan powers this down to long off and takes a single.
Shahbaz Ahmed starts off with a full delivery in line with the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan blocks this to the left of the bowler.
Shahbaz Ahmed comes on to bowl. Will he be as effective as Shakib Al Hasan?
On a fuller length once again and outside the off stump. Litton Das blocks this solidly to the short cover fielder. Good first over for Kuldeep Sen as he concedes just 4 runs.
Goes full this time and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to go hard at the ball but gets an inside edge to deep backward square leg for a single.

On a good length this time and pitching on a leg stump line, gets the ball to shape back in. Shakib Al Hasan looks to block but gets beaten and hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal from the bowler but KL Rahul is convinced. He makes Rohit Sharma go for the review and UltraEdge shows there is no bat involved. Unfortunately, the ball is pitching just outside the leg stump and India lose their review.
Straying onto the pads on a fuller length. Litton Das misses out on this as he finds the deep square leg fielder with his flick for a single.
Goes full once again and into the pads, Litton Das clips this ball towards deep mid-wicket and collects two runs.
Kuldeep Sen starts off with a full delivery just outside off, Litton Das digs this out back towards the bowler.
The debutant Kuldeep Sen is introduced into the attack.
Short ball going down leg side. Shakib Al Hasan ducks under this one and lets it through to the keeper. He looks at the leg umpire and enquires for a wide but does not get it.
Bowls a surprise short ball outside off, Litton Das gets on top of the bounce and pulls this to the left of deep square leg. They get only a single though.
Goes straighter this time on a good length, Litton Das flicks the ball towards mid-wicket.

Brilliant delivery once again! Litton Das is living on the edge here. Deepak Chahar serves this on a good length and outside off. There is some late movement on offer still as the ball beats the outside edge of the bat.
On a good length this time and outside off. Litton Das gets behind the line of the ball and works it towards mid-wicket.
Deepak Chahar bowls this full and angles this into the stumps from just outside off. Litton Das clips this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
We have reached Powerplay 2! India will now be able to place four fielders outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan is up and running! Fuller delivery outside off, Shakib Al Hasan gets forward and frees his arms to play this one through the covers. Gets off the mark with a boundary.
Short and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan sways away and leaves it alone.
Short of a length outside off and nipping in, Shakib Al Hasan gets cramped for room as he tried to cut. The ball drops at this feet.
Back of a length on off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to defend this one on the off side but gets an inside edge that rolls back to the bowler.
Good delivery first up from Mohammed Siraj! Bowls this slightly back of a length and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to play this late but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Shakib Al Hasan makes his way out to the middle. Bangladesh needs his experience to come to the forefront here.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammed Siraj strikes! Good-length delivery on middle, Anamul Haque gets in the line of the ball and pushes it uppishly and straight to mid-wicket. Washington Sundar makes no mistake and accepts it gleefully.
Commentary.Howout: c Washington Sundar b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Tad shorter outside off and shaping away, Litton Das advances down the track to punch this one on the off side. Gets beaten on the outside edge on its way to the keeper.
Continues bowling full and outside off. Litton Das strokes this straight to the mid off fielder.
Goes full this time and attacks the stumps once again. Anamul Haque clips this towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Change in field as a second slip comes in.
This is on a good length and outside off, Anamul Haque mistimes his shot towards cover.

Appeal for LBW! Full and drifting onto the pads, Anamul Haque is late on the flick and gets rapped low on the front leg. India go up in appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Anamul Haque has a word with his partner and goes for the review. UltraEdge shows no bat but it is missing the leg stump on Ball Tracking. Anamul Haque and Bangladesh successfully overturn the decision.
Short and outside off, Anamul Haque punches it off the back foot to cover for a dot.

Slight halt! Litton Das seemed to have pulled a muscle in his left leg as he played his pull shot when he got his boundary. The physios are out and taping up his leg for support. He is up now and we are all set to resume.
Good-length delivery outside off, straightens after pitching, Litton Das gets beaten on the outside edge as he gets beaten again. Litton Das is lucky not to get the edge there.
Back of a length on off, Litton Das defends it off the back foot on the off side for a single.

FOUR! Short and at the batter by Mohammed Siraj, Litton Das advances and pulls this one towards the vacant mid-wicket region. Washington Sundar runs after it but fails to prevent the boundary as his attempt to flick the ball back in goes in vain. Litton Das pulls up as soon as he played that shot and is limping as he runs across.
Back of a length outside off, Anamul Haque opens the bat face and works it off the back foot to third man for a single.
WIDE! Banged in short by Mohammed Siraj and sprays it too far down the leg side, Anamul Haque ducks under it and leaves it alone.
Short of a length on off, Litton Das defends the away going delivery and gets an outside that rolls towards third man for a single.
Beaut of a delivery! Good-length delivery outside off, nips away after pitching and Litton Das gets beaten on the outside edge as he tried to defend.
Fuller on off, Anamul Haque closes the bat face early as he tried to flick this one. Mishits it to mid off for a dot.
Touch shorter outside off and swinging away, Anamul Haque advances down the track and lets it go.
Good-length delivery on off and going away, Litton Das defends it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge that rolls towards fine leg for a single.
Short of a length on off, Litton Das lets the ball to come to him and defends it off the back foot to backward point.
Short and outside off, Litton Das plays this one a bit early while pushing on the off side. Mishits it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Back of a length on off and shaping away, Litton Das leaves it alone through to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Anamul Haque defends this one off the front foot to point for a dot.
Back of a length on off and angling in, Litton Das pushes it wide of mid on and takes a quick single. Dives at the non striker's end to reach his ground.
Short outside off and going away, Litton Das shoulders arms and lets it go to the keeper.
Touch fuller and swinging away, Anamul Haque prods forward and gets a thick outside that rolls towards third man for a single.
Short of a length around off and shaping away, Anamul Haque pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good-length delivery outside off, Anamul Haque defends this from the crease to cover.
Maiden over for Deepak Chahar! This is wider outside off on a good length. Litton Das goes for the expansive drive but is beaten all ends up.

Make that five! This has been beautifully bowled by Deepak Chahar! Delivers this on a good length and just outside off. Litton Das looks to push at the line of the ball but gets beaten by the late movement off the wicket.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Litton Das clips this towards mid-wicket. Four dot balls now.
On a good length once again and outside off, Litton Das punches this to the point fielder. India managing to keep it tight and build some pressure.
Continues bowling on a good length and tempting the batter outside the off stump. Litton Das decides to leave this one alone.
Deepak Chahar bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Litton Das gets his front foot forward and blocks this towards the cover fielder.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole. Anamul Haque decides to leave this alone at the last moment.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Anamul Haque but he will take it gladly! Mohammed Siraj bangs this in short and directs it well at the batter. Anamul Haque looks to pull but gets a top edge that flies over the wicket keeper to the straight fine leg fence for four runs. Mohammed Siraj has a few words to say to the batter.
Bowls this one short and wide outside off. Anamul Haque misses out as he cuts this straight to the point fielder.

Goes really full this time and just outside off, Anamul Haque looks to drive and gets the ball to mid off. Rohit Sharma at slip thinks that this could be pad first but none of the other players seem interested.
On a good length this time and outside the off stump. Anamul Haque gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it towards cover.
Mohammed Siraj goes full and into the pads, Litton Das clips this into the gap towards deep mid-wicket and they take three runs as Washington Sundar gives chase.
Goes full this time and outside the off pole. Anamul Haque looks to go hard at the ball but miscues his shot straight to cover.
Deepak Chahar serves this on a good length and outside the off stump, Anamul Haque knocks this straight to point.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Litton Das shimmies forward before the ball is bowled and cuts it late past backward point for a single.
Goes full and angles this into the stumps, Litton Das shuffles across and clips this towards the mid-wicket fielder.
On a good length once again and on the outside off stump channel. Litton Das shoulders his arms to this one.
Deepak Chahar bowls this on a good length and outside off, with some movement away from the bat. Litton Das taps this towards point.
Bowls this one on a fuller length and wide outside off, Anamul Haque is happy to leave this one alone. 2 runs from Mohammed Siraj's first over.
Goes wide outside off on a good length, Anamul Haque finds the gap in the off side as he pushes this towards deep point and takes a couple of runs.
This is on a good length and outside the off stump. Anamul Haque strokes this firmly to the cover fielder.
Another good delivery from Mohammed Siraj! Continues bowling on a good length and slightly wider outside off. Anamul Haque feels for the ball and is beaten.
This is on a good length as well and outside off, Anamul Haque raises his arms and leaves this one alone.

What a start for Mohammed Siraj! Bowls this on a good length and just outside the off stump. Anamul Haque looks to play at the line of the ball but gets beaten by the sideward movement. The ball misses the edge of the bat and the off pole by a fraction.
It will be Mohammed Siraj to bowl with the new ball from the other end.
Continues bowling full and outside the off pole, Litton Das taps this towards mid on. A wicket and 5 runs in the first over.
Full once again and outside the off stump, Anamul Haque strokes this to the left of mid off and takes a single.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and just outside off, Anamul Haque blocks this back down the pitch towards the bowler.

FOUR! Anamul Haque is off the mark with a boundary! Deepak Chahar goes a touch fuller this time and outside the off pole, Anamul Haque gets a stride forward and crunches this to deep cover-point for Bangladesh's first four.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Anamul Haque blocks this confidently towards cover.
Anamul Haque walks in at number 3 for Bangladesh.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a cracking start for India as Deepak Chahar draws first blood on the very first delivery of the inning! Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump, get the ball to nip away slightly. Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes at the ball and gets an outside edge that flies straight into the palms of Rohit Sharma at first slip. India would have been praying for this kind of a start and they have got it. This is will have the Bangladesh batters wondering.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Deepak Chahar
